blurb.text: A Lazio DOC on the western edge of the Alban Hills, south of Rome, created in 1970. Its wine is mostly Trebbiano and Malvasia Bianca di Candia, a blend like Frascati's, but Trebbiano makes up only 25% to 55% of it.
